name: Joint Base Charleston
description: Joint Base Charleston hosts the 628th Air Base Wing and 437th Airlift Wing operating C-17 Globemaster III missions. Major logistics and mobility hub supporting global operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. Visitor Control Center at Dorchester Gate processes day passes.

gates.name: Rivers Gate (North)
gates.notes: Primary 24-hour access point near I-26 in Hanahan. Convenient for northern housing areas.
gates.address: Rivers Gate, near I-26, Hanahan, SC 29410

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, and family documents. REAL ID required for unescorted base access.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Inns of Charleston (24/7 arrival point) or Unaccompanied Housing for initial lodging. Military Housing Office for family housing assignments.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 628 FSS, M&FRC, and official JB Charleston sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
